title: SmartBear API Entry
description: A single API definition entry in the SwaggerHub registry, including metadata, versions, and access properties.

created.description: Timestamp when the API was created

modified.description: Timestamp when the API was last modified

swaggerUrl.description: URL to the SwaggerHub UI for this API

url.description: Raw URL to the API definition

isPrivate.description: Whether the API is private (true) or public (false)

tags.description: Tags associated with the API for discovery
